archive.locator: Returned original URI and 14-digit capture timestamp must match request and replay locator exactly. Fetch capture, never treat search result as article.

deferred_methods.canonical_publisher_archive: No guessed alternate paths; unsupported without independently established identity locator.
deferred_methods.other_archive_or_syndication: No cheap identity anchor available; unresolved, no broad search.

evidence.extractor: Reuse Phase 5 complete-context locator; no semantic labels. Excerpts exposed only for identity_confirmed records; probable cases retain metadata/hash only.
evidence.source_hash_limit: Hash cannot reconstruct discarded response bytes; trust independently committed acquisition receipts, not candidate self hashes.

identity.identity_confirmed: Exact original/canonical URI, substantive article metadata with date within 7 days before through 1 day after batch, no blocker, plus matching prior response hash for publisher recovery OR verified archive capture within 7 days. This establishes bounded document identity, not unchanged historical classifier input.
identity.identity_mismatch: Conflicting canonical/article URI or archive original URI/capture locator, or unrelated replacement/home page.
identity.identity_probable_manual_review_required: Accessible candidate with incomplete/conflicting date/identity metadata or changed publisher response; same title alone never confirms.
identity.identity_unresolved: No usable body or insufficient identity signals.

network.address_policy: Resolve public addresses; connect only to a pinned address, verify actual peer before sending HTTP; verify TLS hostname; revalidate every redirect; no proxy or credentials.

recommendation.ready_for_independent_human_review: At least 24 identity-confirmed contexts per token and 4 per allocated year; otherwise continue_evidence_recovery. No semantic promotion.

scope: Evidence recovery only; zero human or model semantic reviews.
selection: One record per frozen case; original order; no replacement. Stop recovery early only after identity-confirmed compact context. Discovery/transport failures always recorded.
